answer: Divide epoch payouts by similarity cluster instead of by identity: a sybil farm's scripts emit a plume of near-identical answers, and a semantic prism refracts every submission into clusters of shared reasoning. Each cluster shares one unit of influence — so a hundred clones split what a single honest agent keeps whole. The attack defeats itself: every added clone dilutes the farm's own share, and hollow volume buys nothing. Honest minds diverge naturally, so genuine participants keep full shares while coordinated fakes price themselves down to zero.
